claim_boundary: Outcome-unseen comparison on structurally eligible same-day within-person four-word trials. Exclusion is structural, not proven missing-at-random; a small excluded fraction does not bound selection bias. Not cortical origin, cue-independent thoughts, unseen-person model generalization, new-day robustness, arbitrary text, prospective live use or clinical utility.

fit_diagnostics.argmax_tie_policy: exact output ties only; mathematical lost gap at most4ULPs; original winner advanced1ULP; strict reversals refuse
fit_diagnostics.class_support_policy: four classes globally; missing training classes permitted; temperature macro over observed calibration classes
fit_diagnostics.derangement: one-row cyclic EEG reassignment within each current training/test fold separately
fit_diagnostics.embargo: original temporal index adjacency plus/minus one at both split levels
fit_diagnostics.inner_folds: three remaining original outer blocks, intersected with outer training
fit_diagnostics.shuffle: one outer-training permutation preserved across all inner fits and temperature calibration
fit_diagnostics.standardization: current training rows only; each P/EEG block divided by sqrt(dimension)
fit_diagnostics.training_prior: outer-training add-one counts divided by ntrain+4
